title: Prompt Engineer: Analyzing Hard and Soft Skill Requirements in the AI Job Market
abstract: arXiv:2506.00058v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rise of large language models (LLMs) has prompted speculation about a new job role: the prompt engineer. However, empirical evidence on how common such positions are and what skills employers expect of them remains scarce. In this paper, we present a data-driven analysis of a snapshot of LinkedIn job postings for data and AI roles taken in April 2025, after LLMs had entered everyday work but before LLM-based agents became widely adopted. We analyzed 20,662 job postings on LinkedIn for prompt engineers (72 postings) and four established data and AI roles: data scientist, data engineer, data analyst, and machine learning engineer. We find that prompt engineer roles were rare even at this point in time, making up less than 0.5% of the postings across the five roles we sampled. translated_title: 提示工程师：分析AI就业市场中的硬技能与软技能要求
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）的兴起引发了人们对一种新职业角色的猜测：提示工程师。然而，关于此类职位究竟有多普遍、雇主期望其具备哪些技能的实证证据仍然稀缺。在本文中，我们对2025年4月LinkedIn上数据和AI职位招聘信息的快照进行了数据驱动分析，该时间点处于LLM已进入日常工作之后、但基于LLM的智能体尚未被广泛采用之前。我们分析了LinkedIn上20,662条招聘信息，涵盖提示工程师职位（72条）以及四种成熟的数据和AI职位：数据科学家、数据工程师、数据分析师和机器学习工程师。我们发现，即使在那个时间点，提示工程师职位也十分罕见，在我们抽样的五个职位中占比不到0.5%。由于我们的快照早于基于LLM的智能体的广泛普及，我们认为这些数据捕捉到了提示工程师这一角色在有利条件下的表现……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究对2025年4月LinkedIn上20,662条数据和AI职位招聘信息的分析表明，提示工程师职位极为罕见，在五个相关职位中占比不足0.5%。
en_tdlr: This data-driven analysis of 20,662 LinkedIn job postings from April 2025 reveals that prompt engineer roles were rare, accounting for less than 0.5% of data and AI job postings.
